Definition: a cleaver, i.e. iron armature (of a chariot)
BiblicalUsage: Peladah is the iron armature of a chariot, the flashing fittings the prophet saw. Nahum pictures the chariots with flaming torches in the day of battle, their ironwork catching the light as they shake the streets.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God sees the war-chariots men polish for battle, and no amount of iron saves a city He has judged.
